coverage_explanation: Tests ON/OFF transitions, repeated ON, several explicit PWM values including endpoints, line and idle framing, STATUS reporting, and button-triggered PWM-state reporting. BLINK period, BUZZ frequency/duration, startup state, and report format are unspecified. Consequently, blink/buzzer timing and the textual encoding of reported LED state are not independently asserted.
assumptions: Relies on bench defaults: D13 and D9 LEDs are active HIGH; D2 button connects to GND and uses INPUT_PULLUP.
Commands are uppercase as listed. Newline terminates a command; an unterminated command is accepted after the specified 20 ms idle timeout.
PWM:数值 is interpreted as an Arduino PWM duty value in the standard 0..255 range; only valid values are tested.
STATUS and button reports expose the current PWM value numerically, with arbitrary labels permitted. No particular encoding of LED state is assumed by the checks.
BLINK timing and BUZZ frequency/duration are missing. The reference chooses 500 ms blink half-periods and a 1000 Hz, 200 ms buzz; these choices are not required by the checks.
Initial LED/PWM settings and button debounce duration are unspecified. Tests establish settings explicitly and hold button presses long enough for ordinary debounce.
